source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC03 and CHOICES_AND_STATE.md. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

arrive.text: Daru has stopped distribution from the well. Twelve covered jars remain. Refugees wait beyond the gate. A local elder has written household allocations on a slate.

arrive.speaker: DARU
arrive.text: Clean reserves. Enough until the next caravan if we keep the gate closed.

arrive.speaker: NALI
arrive.caption: [from beyond the gate]
arrive.text: Two of ours cannot swallow. I need water before I need permission.
Tavo recognises Nali's river court accent. Daru hands him the slate.

arrive.speaker: DARU
arrive.text: You've carried messages to Reed Gate. You know which promises come back.

choice.text: Twelve jars. Daru and Nali are waiting for Tavo's answer.

choices.preview: Red Hollow keeps all twelve jars. The refugees stay outside the gate for now.
Six jars go to Nali's people now. Six remain for Red Hollow.
Two jars go to the sick first. Then workers from both sides open the old spring together. Ten jars remain.

choice.speaker: TAVO
choice.text: We keep the twelve jars. I will look for another source.

choice.speaker: NALI
choice.text: I'll remember the answer. I still need that channel open.

choice.speaker: TAVO
choice.text: Six jars for them. Six for us. We both find water.

choice.speaker: NALI
choice.text: Thank you. Who keeps the count tomorrow?

choice.speaker: TAVO
choice.text: Two jars for treatment now. Your pump workers and ours open the old spring together.
Nali agrees to send workers. Daru agrees only if both sides count the water. The two treatment jars go through the gate first.

choice.speaker: NALI
choice.text: One keeper from each side. Neither touches the measuring stick alone.

pipe_take.text: Tavo takes the middle of the pipe. A Red Hollow pump worker lifts one end; one of Nali's people lifts the other.

spring_needs_pipe.text: The old spring's channel is open, but the water has nowhere to go. It needs the pipe.

spring_repair.text: The pipe seats into the old channel. Water gathers in a marked settling bowl.
Nali leaves an attendant to maintain it.

conclude.speaker: DARU
conclude.text: The old line runs through Reed Gate. If its wheel still turns, we can refill here.
Mera examines a seal brought by the refugees.

conclude.speaker: MERA
conclude.text: The fortress keeper is alive. Eren. He signed this.

daru_after.speaker: DARU
daru_after.text: The count is on the slate. Now we see whether it holds.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: I'm not asking you to decide for Daru. I'm asking you to decide.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: Six jars. I'll make them last.

nali.speaker: NALI
nali.text: My workers are ready when yours are.

inspect_jars.text: Twelve covered jars. Clean water, counted twice.
Six jars left. Six went through the gate.
Ten jars. Two went to Nali's sick first.

mera_waiting.speaker: MERA
mera_waiting.text: Settle the water first. I'm reading.

mera_after.speaker: MERA
mera_after.text: Come home. I'll pack your bag.

exit_locked.text: Not while the water is still undecided.
